pick.name: LinkedIn native
pick.what: Profile, native post scheduling (10 min to 3 months ahead), newsletters, Live and analytics
pick.why: Where B2B buyers are; core creator tools are free on every profile
pick.free_limits: Free; scheduling excludes group/event/job posts; Premium optional

alts.name: AuthoredUp
alts.what: Chrome extension for LinkedIn drafting, preview and analytics
alts.why: Best tool once LinkedIn is a real pipeline source

alts.name: Buffer
alts.what: Scheduler that also posts to LinkedIn
alts.why: Use when batch-writing for several networks

decision: LinkedIn is the main channel for B2B and services buyers and its native scheduler and analytics are enough to start. Add AuthoredUp when you post several times a week.
